ModMetaData.name: Rimjob
ModMetaData.author: Ignis & Avis
ModMetaData.description: Rimjob is an independent multiplayer mod for RimWorld maintained by Ignis & Avis. Players remain separate colony owners while sharing the same multiplayer world, with development focused on shared world tiles, independently controlled settlements, player-specific diplomacy and strict pawn ownership boundaries. Rimjob began from the RimWorld Together codebase and retains credit to its original contributors, but is developed independently with its own direction.
